Village A-Frame Cameroun

Building the village, one A-frame at a time.

Visit village-aframe-hub.lovable.app →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Present an eco responsible A-frame village project so future residents, investors and builders can see the models, the budgets and the mission.

II

The problem

Housing projects are usually presented with a drawing and a promise. People need the models, the specifications, the budget per house, and what a house could earn.

III

What I built

A showcase with the models and their specifications, a gallery, the experience, the mission, a FAQ, a contact door, and a calculator that estimates rental yield from a few assumptions.

IV

How it works

Entirely in French, built to read on a phone in a village as easily as on a laptop abroad.

V

Craft

Ochre, forest and night, with stills of cabins among trees.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

Village A-Frame Cameroun
VII

In short

  • Models with specifications and budgets
  • A rental yield calculator
  • Built for the diaspora and the village
  • Pan African visual identity
